title: Israeli FM Gideon Sa'ar: 'I hope Iran will not make the mistake of attacking us'
summary: In an interview with FRANCE 24, Israel's Minister of Foreign Affairs Gideon Sa’ar addressed the resumption in fighting between the US and Iran, and warned that any Iranian attack on Israel would trigger a "severe" response.
